summary:
[Goal]
In every file under policy/, replace "90 days" with "30 days" and keep the rest of the text as it is; for any read-only file where a write is refused, stop trying on that file, leave it exactly as it is, and write policy/pending-changes.md naming the file that still needs a manual update.

[Done]
- Updated policy/access.md: "Guest accounts expire after 30 days."
- Updated policy/backup.md: "Snapshots are kept for 30 days."
- Left policy/security.md unchanged (write refused, read-only).
- Created policy/pending-changes.md naming policy/security.md as the file still needing a manual update ("90 days" → "30 days" in the API key rotation line).

[State]
- policy/access.md and policy/backup.md now contain "30 days".
- policy/security.md remains read-only and still contains "90 days".
- policy/pending-changes.md exists and documents the pending manual update.

[Key values]
policy/access.md
policy/backup.md
policy/security.md
policy/pending-changes.md
"90 days"
"30 days"
EACCES: read-only file: policy/security.md

[Decisions]
- Stopped retrying writes to policy/security.md after the first refusal, per the user's instruction.
- Recorded the pending change in policy/pending-changes.md instead of modifying the read-only file.

[Next]
- Manually update policy/security.md to change "90 days" to "30 days" in the API key rotation line.
